versions.subject: New Rules + Update
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\sc.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'config'
        - 'binPath'
    CommandLine|contains:
        # Add more suspicious commands or binaries
        - 'powershell'
        - 'cmd'
        - 'mshta'
        - 'wscript'
        - 'cscript'
        - 'rundll32'
        # Add more suspicious paths
        - 'C:\Users\Public'
        - '\Downloads\'
        - '\Desktop\'
        - '\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup\'
        - 'C:\Windows\TEMP\'
        - '\AppData\Local\Temp'
condition: selection
